context:
Goal: after you press Mark sold or Undo, the keyboard stays on the button that replaces it, on every screen.
Problem (goal): the builder fixed the Orders walk inside the walk's own row (commit 659c12457). Inventory has the same swap and the same loss of focus, and the cause sits in the shared buttons (MarkSoldButton has no focus handling; UndoSaleButton focuses itself only if it starts out enabled).
Based on (read): the walk fix works (both focus cases green, 26 of 27 walk tests pass; the one red waits on item 122).
Departs from: main, where both screens drop focus to the page — the shared buttons take focus when they replace each other, on Orders and Inventory.
Waiting on: the review of the walk-pane-tally-focus lane; the Orders lane acts on your answer.
holds: The review of lane walk-pane-tally-focus's focus fix waits on this answer.
